technicalReview.scope: Every page in this catalogue, read in catalogue order at about eight a day from 12 to 18 September 2026, with hands-on exploration of the labs. Each page carries its own review date; this entry records the reviewer and the date the pass finished. Lab D’s review covers its lesson text and its model: the discrete-time second-order loop ordering, the SAR bit-trial timing, and the SNR masking and noise-replacement conventions.
